title: The real-lock buy and sell nonce tests prove only the submitBuyTx / submitPrivateSell seams; nothing in the unit suite pins that the V2 and V3 buy sites and the private sell site call the seam, so a site that bypasses the lock stays green

evidence.note: drives mod.submitBuyTx directly; never runs handleNewPairForChain or handleNewV3PoolForChain
drives mod.submitPrivateSell directly; never runs executeFullSell
V2 snipe buy site calls submitBuyTx
V3 snipe buy site calls submitBuyTx

the only source check accepts either submitBuyTx or a direct sendTxWithRetry call (/const realHash = await (submitBuyTx|sendTxWithRetry)\(/) and finds the withNonceLock line in the seam definition itself

sibling_sites_checked: All unit tests that reach the buy or sell submit: bot/snipeFailClean (mocks sendTxWithRetry; a direct call would still be "attempted"), bot/noDoubleBuyReconcile, bot/deliberateBuy* (deliberate path, not the snipe sites), exitEngine/exitInclusionLadder and antiRugReason (lock mocked, AUD-TESTU-003), exitWorkerRealPath and noDoubleSellReconcile (real lock, but a bypass does not deadlock or change their observables).
severity_rationale: S2: the hidden defect is the S1 nonce-collision class the seams were added for (WR-01, INT-NONCE-SELL); the tests are real-path for the seam but blind to the call-site wiring that the bug was about.
recommendation: Phase 28: drive handleNewPairForChain / handleNewV3PoolForChain and executeFullSell with the real lock held from outside and assert that no submit body starts until it is released.
affected_cases: buyNonceLock.test.ts: a buy submit and a same-wallet sell submit do NOT interleave their bodies (serialized by the per-wallet lock)
sellNonceLock.test.ts: a private sell submit and a same-wallet buy submit do NOT interleave their bodies (serialized by the per-wallet lock)
inclusionReconciliation.test.ts: D-RECORD-REAL-HASH: src/bot.ts wires realHash into BOTH the V2 and V3 buy inserts (source/behavior coupling)
escaped_regression: Replace submitBuyTx( with sendTxWithRetry( at src/bot.ts:1100 (the WR-01 bug): buyNonceLock stays green (the seam still exists) and the inclusionReconciliation source regex accepts the direct call. Replace submitPrivateSell( with escalatePrivateSell( at src/exitEngine.ts:909: sellNonceLock stays green.
